solver.kind: blind AI solver (separate agent, answer-free packet, rubric v2)

B034-01.notes: Radius slope 4/3, tangent slope -3/4: y-4=-3/4(x-3), i.e. 3x+4y=25; y=0 gives x=25/3. Requires knowing tangent is perpendicular to radius plus a line equation; many ACT takers will not set this up.

B034-02.notes: Vertex at x=5 (midpoint of roots 2 and 8); f(5)=3(-3)=-9. Trap: 0 (the zeros).

B034-04.notes: Factors of 5: floor(25/5)+floor(25/25)=5+1=6. Trap: 5 (missing the extra 5 in 25). A calculator shows 25! only in scientific notation, so it can't be read off.

B034-05.notes: Midsegment = average of the bases: (10+x)/2=16, so x=22. Needs the midsegment fact; trap 6 (16-10).

B034-06.notes: Odd degree with negative leading coefficient: f goes to -inf as x goes to +inf, and to +inf as x goes to -inf.

flags: minor: 'bounces indefinitely' is an idealization; acceptable for a geometric-series item
B034-09.notes: 10 + 2*(6/(1-3/5)) = 10 + 2*15 = 40. Traps: 25 (one-way sum), 30 (counting only the up legs plus the drop, wrongly).

B034-10.notes: 1 - (12*11*10)/12^3 = 1 - 1320/1728 = 408/1728 = 17/72. Trap: 55/72 is the all-different probability. Needs the complement setup.

B034-11.notes: Side s: r_in=s/2, r_out=s/sqrt2; area ratio (1/4)/(1/2) = 1:2. Trap: 1:sqrt2 (radius ratio).
